prompt: A compact street-corner diorama on a square slab of wet pavement in a rain city: a short section of riveted steel girder elevated railway passing overhead on two thick riveted steel columns, and beneath it the entrance to a basement jazz bar: a narrow brick facade, a stairwell with iron handrails going down to a basement door under a small curved metal awning, a tall vertical projecting sign box on a bracket beside the door with a plain circular ring shape at its top, a fire escape on the wall above, and an old street lamp on the corner. Noir city hardware, the sign frames empty, no readable letters. Isolated 3D model render on a plain uniform medium-grey studio background, the whole object fully in frame with generous margin, three-quarter view from slightly above, soft even studio lighting, no cast shadow, no text, no lettering, no logos, no people. Crisp hard-surface modelling with bold, clearly separated parts and a strong readable silhouette: chunky forms and clean edges, no clutter, no hanging moss, no dangling wires.
